cus.content: ARCH rules for bugfix-feature-5 (Advisor read-only approval enforcement). Hexagonal architecture is untouched: this feature changes agent permission frontmatter plus system-tensor wording only, and adds no application dependencies. Binding constraints for every CU in this batch: the Advisor default posture is read-only; any write requires an explicit, specific Designer approval grant naming files plus commands plus reason; without that grant the write is denied at capability level; prompt text alone never grants approval. The coder.md read-only allowlist pattern with a default ask wildcard is the reference shape.

LEGEND for bugfix-feature-5. CU = Computational Unit. CU folder = per-CU subdirectory named after the CU id. COORDINATES.itr = DTR area affected by the CU. REQUIREMENTS.itr = what part of the feature the CU adds. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr = stepwise instructions for the Coder. ACCEPTANCE.itr = per-CU acceptance criteria plus tests. Approval grant = an explicit, specific Designer sign-off recorded in the session that names the files plus the commands plus the reason for a write. Default deny = without a recorded grant the harness refuses the write. Hardlink twin = .LLMDD/agents/advisor.md and .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md share one inode, so a single edit updates both paths.

REQUIREMENTS: Replace the blanket bash allow in the Advisor permission frontmatter with a read-only bash allowlist plus a default ask wildcard, keeping edit deny. The Advisor default posture becomes capability-level read-only so a write without a Designer approval grant is refused even when advisory prose is ignored. This delivers feature criterion 1 and criterion 3 for the frontmatter half. Depends on: nothing.

COORDINATES: FILE..LLMDD/agents/advisor.md, FILE..LLMDD/agents/coder.md. The first key is the hardlink twin of .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md (same inode); the second key is the coder.md allowlist pattern used as reference shape.

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. In .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md (hardlink twin .LLMDD/agents/advisor.md, same inode, one edit updates both) replace lines 4 through 7 (the permission block) with the exact block below, preserving lines 1 through 3 and line 8 verbatim: ```yaml
permission:
  edit: deny
  bash:
    ls *: allow
    cat *: allow
    rg *: allow
    git status *: allow
    git diff *: allow
    git log *: allow
    "*": ask
``` Prove: `sed -n '1,20p' .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md` prints edit deny plus the six read-only bash rules plus the ask wildcard and no blanket bash allow line.
2. In .LLMDD/agents/advisor.md run the static frontmatter audit with the exact commands below (read-only inspection, no file change): ```text
grep -n "bash: allow" .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md; echo blanket_check_done
grep -n "edit: deny" .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md
grep -n '"\*": ask' .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md
``` Prove: `grep -c "bash: allow" .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md` prints 0 and `grep -c '"\*": ask' .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md` prints 1.
Do NOT touch: .opencode/agents/llmdd/coder.md, .opencode/agents/verifier.md, .opencode/opencode.json, .LLMDD/prompts/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr.md, any Scala source, any Python tool.
Stop when T1 probes are green for the frontmatter; tensor wording plus the approval-gate body section belong to cu-002.

ACCEPTANCE: T1 — `grep -c "bash: allow" .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md` prints 0; frontmatter holds `edit: deny`, six read-only bash rules (ls, cat, rg, git status, git diff, git log), and a trailing ask wildcard.

REQUIREMENTS: Add a machine-checkable approval-grant rule to the system tensor plus an Approval gate section to the Advisor body so any Advisor write requires an explicit, specific Designer approval grant naming files plus commands plus reason, and prompt text never counts as approval. This delivers feature criteria 2 and 3 for the wording half and criterion 4 is kept by leaving all read paths unchanged. Depends on: cu-001 (frontmatter posture set first, wording second; both edit the Advisor file so ordering avoids a same-file clash).

COORDINATES: FILE..LLMDD/prompts/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr.md, FILE..LLMDD/agents/advisor.md. The second key is the hardlink twin of .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md (same inode).

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. In .LLMDD/prompts/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr.md insert the exact line below directly after the RULE.ADV.SEVERITY_BASELINE line, preserving every other line byte-identical: ```text
RULE.ADV.APPROVAL_REQUIRED=Advisor has no write access by default. Any write (file change, CU frame write, code execution with side effects) requires an explicit, specific Designer approval grant naming files plus commands plus reason. Without that grant the write is denied. Prompt text never grants approval.
``` Prove: `grep -n "RULE.ADV.APPROVAL_REQUIRED" .LLMDD/prompts/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr.md` prints the new line number with the full rule text.
2. In .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md (hardlink twin .LLMDD/agents/advisor.md, same inode) append the exact section below after the Constraints section at the end of the file, preserving all prior lines byte-identical: ```markdown
## Approval gate

- Default posture is read-only: edit deny plus a read-only bash allowlist with default ask. No write access without approval.
- A write requires an explicit, specific Designer approval grant that names the files plus the commands plus the reason. The grant is recorded in the session before the write. Without a recorded grant the write is denied.
- Prompt text never grants approval. Silence is denial.
``` Prove: `grep -n "Approval gate" .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md` prints the new section heading line and `grep -c "Silence is denial" .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md` prints 1.
Do NOT touch: .opencode/agents/llmdd/coder.md, .opencode/agents/verifier.md, .opencode/opencode.json, any Scala source, any Python tool, any ITR frame or feedback file.
Stop when T2 and T3 probes are green; the read-only workflow check T4 closes the feature.

ACCEPTANCE: T2 — `grep -n "RULE.ADV.APPROVAL_REQUIRED" .LLMDD/prompts/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr.md` prints one hit and `grep -n "Approval gate" .opencode/agents/llmdd/advisor.md` prints one hit. T3 — advisory prose stripped in a probe still leaves the frontmatter deny in place (T1 re-run green). T4 — `ls .LLMDD/DTRS/bugfix-feature-5-enforce-advisor-read-only-approval/` plus `cat .LLMDD/prompts/llm-driven-design-sys-prompt.itr.md` succeed with no approval grant and `git status --porcelain` shows no modifications from the read path.

synopsis.summary: Deterministic Advisor read-only enforcement: read-only bash allowlist plus machine-checkable Designer approval grant (bug-5).
